profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer iii
profile.summary: Full stack Senior Software Engineer with years of professional experience and a passion for clean, functional code. A team player, a strong communicator who excels in fast-paced environments. I have a wide range of experience from front-end development using Angular 12 with Ngrx and Rxjs, to backend development using Node/Express/Nestjs to help provide solutions to complex business problems. I believe in using the right tool for the job, but always keeping it simple and effective. My goal is to work for a company where I can utilize and challenge my skills and grow
